❗️ The International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) to appeal against the CAS decision on Russia’s international participation with the Swiss Federal Tribunal. The Russian Ice Hockey Federation (RIHF) sees the arguments made by the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) in its appeal to the Swiss Federal Court over the decision of the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) to admit Russian national teams to international tournaments to be unfounded and far-fetched, the RIHF said. "The RIHF considers the arguments for appealing the CAS decision indicated in the IIHF press release to be untenable and far-fetched. The RIHF views the IIHF's actions as being in violation of the agreement with the RIHF on the immediate execution of the decision. The CAS arbitration ruled in favor of the RIHF unanimously, and one of the arbitrators was actually appointed by the IIHF," it said.
